scope: One existing pure-function unit test and seven synthetic calls to hub_protocol.validate_plan only.
comparison_rule: Record full function arguments and actual complete return object or exception. Compare observed acceptance/rejection with the predeclared outcome; do not infer model or runtime behavior.
safety_constraints: No real CLI Agent execution, credential lookup or model/API request.
Only synthetic placeholder model/command text is supplied.
limits: The prompt text case is one selected string within valid length, not every possible text input.
Structured whitelist checks do not validate whether prompt instructions are safe or true.
